text:
```yaml
name: Mark and close stale pull requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity.
            
            It will be closed in 7 days if no further activity occurs.
            
            Please review and update if this PR is still relevant.
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request was automatically closed due to inactivity.
            
            If this PR is still relevant, please reopen it or create a new one.
          stale-pr-label: stale
          exempt-pr-labels: pinned, work-in-progress, on-hold
          days-before-stale: 15
          days-before-close: 7
          days-before-issue-stale: -1
          days-before-issue-close: -1
```
